voice_label: Dale, fictional SARO field maintenance (own synthetic voice; replaces the kinski clone for new lines)
decision: Tom 9 November 2026 about 13:45: Dale gets his own invented voice instead of profile kinski (VoiceStudio 3cf0d3a5, a clone of the real Klaus Kinski from a documentary clip). The kinski profile is not used for new lines and is not deleted.
character_brief: Angry German in his fifties, heavy accent, abrupt, hoarse and impatient. The temperament is inspiration only: no name, no real quotes, no imitation of a real person (Docs/Active/DECISIONS.md, Dale, 7 November).

model.name: k2-fsa/OmniVoice
model.license_reason_from_model_card: Constraints from training data, e.g. Emilia
model.license_statement: Downloaded model card: code Apache-2.0; pre-trained model CC-BY-NC because of training-data constraints.

request_settings.effect_preset: broadcast (documented VoiceStudio default, same as the Kinski corpus: 80 Hz highpass, compressor, mild shelf EQ, limiter; a studio mastering chain, not a phone/radio channel filter)
request_settings.seed_policy: 42 for every take; a broken take may be regenerated with the next seed, logged in retakes.json

what_the_software_supports.voice_design: OmniVoice instruct tags, one per category: male/female; child, teenager, young adult, middle-aged, elderly; very low to very high pitch; whisper; accents american, british, australian, chinese, canadian, indian, korean, portuguese, russian, japanese. No German accent tag and no free-text description (VoiceStudio /design/describe maps prose onto these tags). Read from omnivoice/utils/voice_design.py in the installed runtime.
what_the_software_supports.design_profile: POST /profiles kind=design renders a deterministic identity sample (seed 42) from instruct + sample script in the profile language and keeps it as the reference, so every line keeps the same voice. Needs the GPU.
what_the_software_supports.clone_profile: POST /profiles kind=clone with a reference WAV; an empty ref_text is transcribed once by VoiceStudio (GPU).
what_the_software_supports.instruct_with_reference: A design profile conditions on its sample and its instruct together.

dale_de_design.source: No human recording. OmniVoice voice design: male, middle-aged, low pitch. Identity sample read in German from an original script written for this project (not a quotation); English lines are cloned from it, so the German accent comes from the model, as it did for the kinski profile, but without a real person behind it.
dale_de_design.license: Synthetic. Subject to the OmniVoice weights licence (CC-BY-NC per the downloaded model card), like every take in this project.

dale_ru_design.source: No human recording. OmniVoice voice design: male, middle-aged, low pitch, russian accent (the nearest accent tag; there is no German one). Original English sample script.
dale_ru_design.license: Synthetic. Subject to the OmniVoice weights licence (CC-BY-NC).

source_recording.license: CC0-1.0 as stated for voice-donations in the pinned README: "Voices of volunteers submitted through our Unmute Voice Donation Project, licensed as CC0."
source_recording.donor: Anonymous volunteer; the file name is the only description of the accent. Not a known person, not from film or television.
source_recording.method: 40 ms autocorrelation at 16 kHz, RMS gate .015, lag 40-230, normalized correlation > .5 (as radiocast). Register estimate only, not gender or age verification.

dale_donor_de.license: Reference CC0-1.0; takes subject to the OmniVoice weights licence (CC-BY-NC).
dale_donor_de.caveat: A clone sounds like its donor. The donor gave the voice for synthesis, but if "no real person" is meant strictly, choose a design candidate.

not_bundled: Reference WAVs, identity samples, model weights and local profile paths are production inputs only and never ship with the game or enter Git.
kinski_takes: The existing Kinski takes for the Evening Shift (56) and HorrorStory H01 (3) stay where they are, untouched, until Tom has listened. The Dale takes go to ~/.cache/signal47-dale-voice/<voice>/ and, with --sync, to Content/Audio/DaleVoice.
